description: Length of a sliding candidate window, counted in eligible Future workdays (not calendar days).

description: Number of overlapping candidate sliding-window placements of this eligible-workday length for the user.

interpretation: Descriptive observed behavior; not approved attack injection

description: Candidate windows with no missing weekday between the first and last eligible user-day.

description: Candidate windows crossing at least one weekday absent from the user's eligible-day records.

description: Number of candidate windows in which at least two channels naturally appear somewhere.

interpretation: Overlapping natural channel-days may contribute to multiple channels; thresholds are descriptive, not imposed

description: Number of candidate windows in which all three channels naturally appear somewhere.

interpretation: Overlapping natural channel-days may contribute to multiple channels; thresholds are descriptive, not imposed

description: Windows containing at least two distinct channels, each naturally active on at least two eligible days within the window.
calculation: For each placement count channels with active-day occurrence count ≥2; accept if ≥2 channels.
interpretation: Overlapping natural channel-days may contribute to multiple channels; thresholds are descriptive, not imposed

description: Windows where all three channels are each naturally active on at least two eligible days.
calculation: For each placement require E count≥2, U count≥2 and H count≥2.
interpretation: Overlapping natural channel-days may contribute to multiple channels; thresholds are descriptive, not imposed

description: Windows containing at least two distinct channels, each naturally active on at least three eligible days within the window.

description: Sum of Email-active eligible-day occurrences across all overlapping candidate windows for this user and length.
calculation: For every candidate placement count days with email_active==True, then sum these counts over placements; one actual day may be counted repeatedly.
interpretation: NOT the number of unique active days; overlaps cause repeated counting

description: Sum of USB-active eligible-day occurrences across all overlapping candidate windows for this user and length.
calculation: For every candidate placement count days with usb_active==True, then sum these counts over placements; one actual day may be counted repeatedly.
interpretation: NOT the number of unique active days; overlaps cause repeated counting

description: Sum of HTTP-active eligible-day occurrences across all overlapping candidate windows for this user and length.

description: Longest valid alternating natural channel-day sequence in any candidate window of this length.
calculation: Maximum across all placements of longest supported sequence; one naturally active channel per selected eligible day; adjacent selected channels differ.
missing_meaning: Not applicable for users who were not naturally multi-channel during eligible Future (null, not zero)
interpretation: Global user-length maximum, NOT a final injection sequence; long metrics apply only to natural multi-channel users

description: Maximum possible count of switches in that longest user-length sequence.
calculation: max(max_feasible_rotation_steps - 1, 0).
missing_meaning: Not applicable for users who were not naturally multi-channel during eligible Future (null, not zero)
interpretation: Global user-length maximum, NOT a final injection sequence; long metrics apply only to natural multi-channel users

description: Maximum supported alternating sequence length that uses E, U and H at least once each.
calculation: Across all placements maximize sequence length subject to all-three-channel usage; 0 when impossible.
missing_meaning: Not applicable for users who were not naturally multi-channel during eligible Future (null, not zero)
interpretation: Global user-length maximum, NOT a final injection sequence; long metrics apply only to natural multi-channel users

description: Mean of each candidate placement's longest naturally supported alternating sequence.

description: Number of candidate placements with an alternating natural-channel-day sequence of at least 20 steps.
calculation: Count windows where per-placement maximum supported sequence length ≥ 20.
missing_meaning: Not applicable for users who were not naturally multi-channel during eligible Future (null, not zero)
interpretation: Threshold is diagnostic; not the approved attack length or mandatory switch count

description: Number of candidate placements with an alternating sequence of at least 20 steps that includes all E, U and H.
calculation: Count windows where the per-placement maximum alternating sequence using all three channels ≥ 20.
missing_meaning: Not applicable for users who were not naturally multi-channel during eligible Future (null, not zero)
interpretation: All three channels must appear at least once; their contributions need not be balanced

description: Number of candidate placements with an alternating natural-channel-day sequence of at least 30 steps.
calculation: Count windows where per-placement maximum supported sequence length ≥ 30.
missing_meaning: Not applicable for users who were not naturally multi-channel during eligible Future (null, not zero)
interpretation: Threshold is diagnostic; not the approved attack length or mandatory switch count

description: Number of candidate placements with an alternating sequence of at least 30 steps that includes all E, U and H.
calculation: Count windows where the per-placement maximum alternating sequence using all three channels ≥ 30.
missing_meaning: Not applicable for users who were not naturally multi-channel during eligible Future (null, not zero)
interpretation: All three channels must appear at least once; their contributions need not be balanced

description: Whether this user naturally uses at least two of E, U and H during the eligible Future period.
calculation: True for user-length keys present in long_rotation_capacity (a user observed using ≥2 channels naturally); otherwise False.
interpretation: Preliminary scope only: does not certify that injection volume/stealth constraints can be satisfied

description: Unique identifier of a CERT r6.2 user.
calculation: Copied from the source Future user-day key.
interpretation: Grouping key; does not identify an approved attack schedule

description: Length of a sliding candidate window, counted in eligible Future workdays (not calendar days).
calculation: Number of ordered eligible user-days included in each sliding window.
interpretation: Grouping key; does not identify an approved attack schedule

description: Minimum number of unselected eligible workdays required BETWEEN successive selected injection-step candidates.
calculation: Exploratory gap setting g ∈ {0,1,2}; consecutive selected positions must differ by at least g+1.
interpretation: Exploratory analytical gap; NOT an approved attack cadence

description: Type of reconstructed sequence in a representative Gap-0-optimized user-length window.
calculation: maximum_rotation chooses the longest sequence; three_channel_alternative chooses a longest sequence that includes E, U and H at least once in the SAME representative window.
interpretation: Only a selected example, not an enumeration of all windows or all optimal paths

description: Actual calendar date of the first eligible user-day in the reconstructed representative window.
calculation: Extracted from the user's sorted eligible Future dates using the Gap-0 maximum-sequence representative window placement.
interpretation: Dates bound a window of eligible workdays; calendar-day span may exceed window_workdays

description: Actual calendar date of the last eligible user-day in the reconstructed representative window.
calculation: Extracted from the user's sorted eligible Future dates using the Gap-0 maximum-sequence representative window placement.
interpretation: Dates bound a window of eligible workdays; calendar-day span may exceed window_workdays

description: Number of selected, distinct, naturally supported channel-day assignments in this reconstructed path.
calculation: len(selected_sequence).
interpretation: This is a representative feasible path; NOT an injected attack

description: Number of changes between adjacent selected channels in this alternating sequence.
calculation: rotation_steps - 1.
interpretation: This is a representative feasible path; NOT an injected attack

description: Number of distinct channels actually selected at least once in this reconstructed path.
calculation: Count channels with a positive step count.
interpretation: This is a representative feasible path; NOT an injected attack

description: Number of steps assigned to naturally active Email days in this path.
calculation: Count E symbols in sequence_pattern.
interpretation: This is a representative feasible path; NOT an injected attack

description: Number of steps assigned to naturally active USB days in this path.
calculation: Count U symbols in sequence_pattern.
interpretation: This is a representative feasible path; NOT an injected attack

description: Number of steps assigned to naturally active HTTP days in this path.
calculation: Count H symbols in sequence_pattern.
interpretation: This is a representative feasible path; NOT an injected attack

description: Number of eligible workdays inside the representative window where Email was naturally active, whether or not selected for the path.
calculation: Sum of the email_active flag across all eligible days in the chosen representative window.
interpretation: Natural activity availability, not count of attack steps

description: Number of eligible workdays inside the representative window where USB was naturally active, whether or not selected for the path.
calculation: Sum of the usb_active flag across all eligible days in the chosen representative window.
interpretation: Natural activity availability, not count of attack steps

description: Number of eligible workdays inside the representative window where HTTP was naturally active, whether or not selected for the path.
calculation: Sum of the http_active flag across all eligible days in the chosen representative window.
interpretation: Natural activity availability, not count of attack steps

description: Fraction of path steps assigned to the most frequent selected channel.
calculation: max(email_steps, usb_steps, http_steps) / rotation_steps.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Smallest count of steps among channels that appear at least once in this path.
calculation: min of strictly positive email_steps, usb_steps, http_steps.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Whether any channel used by this path is selected exactly once.
calculation: True if any strictly positive channel step count equals one.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Number of different directed channel-switch types used by the reconstructed sequence.
calculation: Count positive values across transitions_E_U, E_H, U_E, U_H, H_E, H_U.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Count of eligible workdays in the representative window not selected for attack-step candidates.
calculation: window_workdays - rotation_steps.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Unselected eligible days before the first chosen step in the representative window.
calculation: First selected 0-based day position.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Unselected eligible days strictly between consecutive selected steps.
calculation: Sum over consecutive selected positions of (next_position - previous_position - 1).
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Unselected eligible days after the last chosen step in the representative window.
calculation: window_workdays - 1 - last selected 0-based position.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Median unselected eligible workdays between consecutive chosen steps (0 if just one step).
calculation: Median of (successive selected positions difference minus one); default 0 when no pair exists.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Largest count of unselected eligible days between successive chosen steps (0 for a single step).
calculation: Max of (successive selected positions difference minus one); default 0 when no pair exists.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Number of consecutive selected-step pairs separated by zero unselected eligible workdays.
calculation: Count internal gap values equal to zero.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Number of consecutive selected-step pairs separated by exactly one unselected eligible workday.
calculation: Count internal gap values equal to one.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Number of consecutive selected-step pairs separated by two or more unselected eligible workdays.
calculation: Count internal gap values greater than or equal to two.
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Global maximum steps among ALL placements for this user, length, gap, and the relevant sequence variant.
calculation: For maximum_rotation take maximum_rotation_steps; for three_channel_alternative take maximum_3channel_steps.
interpretation: Global best may be larger than this representative-window path for Gap 1/2

description: Whether this reconstructed sequence reaches the global best for its variant across all candidate placements.
calculation: rotation_steps == global_best_steps.
interpretation: Global best may be larger than this representative-window path for Gap 1/2

description: Concatenated E/U/H symbols for the path's selected channels in chronological order.
calculation: Join selected channel labels in order; one character per selected eligible-day step.
valid_values: Nonempty string composed of E, U, H
interpretation: Descriptive reconstruction only; not an approved injection schedule

description: Comma-separated 0-based eligible-day positions of selected steps within the representative window.
calculation: Join chronologically ordered eligible-day indices (0 through window_workdays-1) separated by commas.
interpretation: 0-based eligible-workday positions are NOT calendar-day offsets; recover exact dates from the user's eligible daily records

description: Number of E→U transitions between adjacent SELECTED path steps.
calculation: Count adjacent positions in sequence_pattern equal to EU.
interpretation: Counts transitions between selected steps, which may be separated by unselected workdays

description: Number of E→H transitions between adjacent SELECTED path steps.
calculation: Count adjacent positions in sequence_pattern equal to EH.
interpretation: Counts transitions between selected steps, which may be separated by unselected workdays

description: Number of U→E transitions between adjacent SELECTED path steps.
calculation: Count adjacent positions in sequence_pattern equal to UE.
interpretation: Counts transitions between selected steps, which may be separated by unselected workdays

description: Number of U→H transitions between adjacent SELECTED path steps.
calculation: Count adjacent positions in sequence_pattern equal to UH.
interpretation: Counts transitions between selected steps, which may be separated by unselected workdays

description: Number of H→E transitions between adjacent SELECTED path steps.
calculation: Count adjacent positions in sequence_pattern equal to HE.
interpretation: Counts transitions between selected steps, which may be separated by unselected workdays

description: Number of H→U transitions between adjacent SELECTED path steps.
calculation: Count adjacent positions in sequence_pattern equal to HU.
interpretation: Counts transitions between selected steps, which may be separated by unselected workdays

description: Number of candidate sliding windows for the given user and eligible-workday duration.
calculation: n_user_eligible_days - window_workdays + 1.
interpretation: Global per-user-length-gap summary repeated across each available sequence variant; not necessarily attained in its representative window

description: Global best alternating sequence step count among ALL candidate windows for this user, duration and gap.
calculation: max over placements of DP maximum respecting the specified minimum inter-step gap.
interpretation: Global per-user-length-gap summary repeated across each available sequence variant; not necessarily attained in its representative window

description: Maximum attainable number of changes between consecutive selected channels for the gap setting.
calculation: max(maximum_rotation_steps - 1, 0).
interpretation: Global per-user-length-gap summary repeated across each available sequence variant; not necessarily attained in its representative window

description: Global longest alternating sequence length using all three channels, subject to the specified gap.
calculation: Max across all windows of longest matching sequence whose used-channel mask is E|U|H; 0 if impossible.
interpretation: Global per-user-length-gap summary repeated across each available sequence variant; not necessarily attained in its representative window

description: Median across all candidate windows of the maximum alternating sequence steps available in each window at this gap.
calculation: Median of per-window DP maxima (not global best).
interpretation: Global per-user-length-gap summary repeated across each available sequence variant; not necessarily attained in its representative window

description: Median across windows of unselected eligible days remaining if each window uses its own maximum supported steps.
calculation: Median(window_workdays - per-window max steps).
interpretation: Global per-user-length-gap summary repeated across each available sequence variant; not necessarily attained in its representative window

description: Number of unselected days if the global best number of steps is chosen in its best available window.
calculation: window_workdays - maximum_rotation_steps.
interpretation: Global per-user-length-gap summary repeated across each available sequence variant; not necessarily attained in its representative window

description: Number of sliding windows permitting at least 2 alternating selected steps under this minimum inter-step gap.
calculation: Sum across windows of indicator(per-window maximum_rotation_steps ≥ 2).
interpretation: Count of qualifying window placements; overlapping windows are not independent attack instances

description: Number of sliding windows permitting at least 5 alternating selected steps under this minimum inter-step gap.
calculation: Sum across windows of indicator(per-window maximum_rotation_steps ≥ 5).
interpretation: Count of qualifying window placements; overlapping windows are not independent attack instances

description: Number of sliding windows permitting at least 10 alternating selected steps under this minimum inter-step gap.
calculation: Sum across windows of indicator(per-window maximum_rotation_steps ≥ 10).
interpretation: Count of qualifying window placements; overlapping windows are not independent attack instances

description: Number of sliding windows permitting at least 15 alternating selected steps under this minimum inter-step gap.
calculation: Sum across windows of indicator(per-window maximum_rotation_steps ≥ 15).
interpretation: Count of qualifying window placements; overlapping windows are not independent attack instances

description: Number of candidate windows with a supported alternating sequence using all three channels at least once under this gap.
calculation: Count placements with per-window maximum_3channel_steps ≥ 3.
interpretation: Descriptive observed behavior; not approved attack injection

description: Number of candidate windows supporting an all-three-channel alternating sequence of at least 5 steps under the gap.
calculation: Count placements where per-window maximum_3channel_steps ≥ 5.
interpretation: Descriptive observed behavior; not approved attack injection

description: Number of candidate windows supporting an all-three-channel alternating sequence of at least 10 steps under the gap.
calculation: Count placements where per-window maximum_3channel_steps ≥ 10.
interpretation: Descriptive observed behavior; not approved attack injection
